summary_out.hypothesis: Cross-island migrations gen-1 through gen-4 establish that composing strictly orthogonal SKIP axes ON TOP of an unmodified base is the most reliable PnL mechanism in the experiment. G1L2's opposite-tape gate is a signed-flow axis (book direction + per-quote OFI direction); rolling-spread-p75 is a book-distance axis (absolute quote-distance, side-agnostic). These are structurally near-independent (a quote can be wide-spread regardless of which side has the heavier resting size; OFI can be strongly adverse regardless of spread width), so the union of skip sets should cover a strictly larger top-cost slice without redundancy. OR-skip composition (not AND-skip) preserves G1L2's skip set as a strict subset, ensuring the new total is at least as good. Choice over the alternative passive-child-placement branch: that candidate structurally resembled the gen-1 'recover rejected entries' pattern that failed on three independent loops (afg g1l1/g1l2, vrs g1l2) — re-admitting opposite-tape entries as LIMIT children would re-admit the exact slice G1L2 established as highest-cost, and the IS-vs-PnL dissonance warning argues against trusting a better arrival price to compensate for fighting fresh adverse flow.
summary_out.next: Two G1L4 directions, ordered by structural orthogonality from the existing two-axis composition: (1) **Add a choppiness-ratio third SKIP axis** (chop_neutral=1.5, base-agnostic per gen-3; window=30 ticks per island-2 g1l1) — encodes price-PATH whipsaw, structurally distinct from book-distance (spread) and signed-flow (opposite-tape). Cleanest first composed-three-axis candidate because chop is the gen-3-confirmed third orthogonal axis and 1.5 has been verified base-robust across afg/ptg/vrs. (2) **Top-of-book size-asymmetry as third axis** (ratio=1.5, ported from gen-3 island-1 g3l2 / island-2 g3l2) — encodes book DEPTH state. Deferred to G1L4-or-later because size_asym uses bid/ask size ratios that partially overlap with Lipton's imbalance I in the opposite-tape gate (ratio 1.5 maps to |I|≈0.20, below G1L2's 0.33 cut but still partly redundant). Cross-island: the sig island's two-gate composition confirms the gen-2 generalizable (1) rule extends to a base whose existing gate is itself a microstructure composition; the gen-1 IS-vs-PnL dissonance warning can be RESOLVED by adding a book-distance axis that removes the high-IS-cost slice the signed-flow axis was leaving intact; and spread q=0.75/60s/min_samples=50 is now confirmed verbatim-portable across FOUR bases (ptg, afg, vrs, sig) without per-base retune.
